messages:
mina: Heads-up: CI linkcheck flagged several broken fragment links after the mdx rollout. Most are anchors that used to keep punctuation.

ci-bot: build: docs/mkdocs: linkcheck failed (exit 2). see https://ci.redwood/example/7801 for log. 6 broken fragments. :warning:

devin: sample log lines:
```
WARNING: broken link: ../guides/perf#batch-size -> 404
WARNING: broken link: ../reference/cli#deploy-command -> 404
```

mina: pattern: headings with inline code or parentheses changed slugs. e.g. `## Batch size (--batch)` got normalized to `#batch-size--batch` previously but now collapses parentheses.

devin: quick plan: surgical fixes only for CI-reported pages. add explicit header ids using `{#...}` with ascii kebab-case. less noisy than changing slugifier.

mina: agreed. also add a short CONTRIBUTING note that asks authors to add explicit ids when headings contain code/emoji/paren. keeps links stable.

devin: I'll open a small PR touching only the affected files and include a tiny script `scripts/suggest_ids.py` that maps linkcheck failures -> candidate ids so reviewers can confirm.

doc-bot: suggestion: consider a future CI step that parses linkcheck output and posts suggested anchor ids as a PR comment. filed issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/230 to track.

ci-bot: re-run queued when PR branch updates.

mina: PR ready at https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4520. includes 5 explicit ids + CONTRIBUTING blurb. local mkdocs linkcheck passes on my machine.

devin: reviewing now. small nit: prefer `deploy-command` instead of `deploy` to reduce ambiguity.

mina: updated and pushed. thanks. will merge on green.

(last) devin: thanks all. nice small patch, much better than bulk slug changes. merging once CI is green. :thumbsup:
